name: Beszel
description: Lightweight server monitoring with historical metrics, Docker stats, alerts, and a clean web dashboard.

configFields.label: Initial user email
configFields.help: Email for the first Beszel account. Change it in Beszel after signing in if needed.

configFields.label: Initial user password
configFields.help: Auto-generated password for the first Beszel account.

connection.title: Sign in to Beszel
connection.description: Open the monitoring hub, then install a Beszel agent on each system you want to monitor.

guide.intro: Beszel stores monitoring history in its persistent data volume. Agents connect back to this hub from each monitored system.
guide.useHint: Sign in first, add a system, then follow Beszel's generated agent installation instructions.

outputs.label: Beszel Hub
outputs.help: Open the monitoring dashboard in your browser.

firstLogin.note: Use the generated credentials above, then change the email or password in Beszel if needed. Install agents from the Add System screen; the hub template does not mount the host Docker socket.
